Anomaly propagation patterns indicate cascading failures originating from a single service, with timing correlations showing initial failures immediately following the fault injection.

This explains why mobservice1 appeared prominent in predictions—it experienced significant impact as a direct consumer, creating a masking effect where dependent services show more severe symptoms when a dependency fails. The service that first deviated from normal operational parameters at the exact time of fault injection was mobservice2, making it the definitive root cause despite not being the top-ranked candidate in initial predictions.

**Final Answer:** mobservice2
